global: This is miso ramen, its rich, amber broth speckled with seasoning. Chashu pork and menma rest atop noodles, garnished with green onions. A red-rimmed bowl holds it, set on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle scratches, showing natural texture and warm tone.
regions.bowl: Red and white ceramic bowl with hand-painted red rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly chipped edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions, shows rich brown color and glossy surface.
regions.chopsticks: Light wooden chopsticks, smooth and slightly tapered, rest diagonally with natural grain visible on their surfaces.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, caramelized slices with glistening surface, irregular shape, and visible marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curved shapes, showing subtle surface striations.
